fields.description: Slot 0 active flag: raw save byte0 copied verbatim by FUN_08028448 and tested nonzero (=active golfer) by FUN_08028750.
fields.evidence: FUN_08028448 copies save byte0 (*param_1=*param_2); FUN_08028750 sets active=(*param_1!=0); slot stride 0x82 selected by FUN_080290b8/FUN_0802907c; EEPROM load FUN_08028ee8 / store FUN_08028fa4 via FUN_0804ee20/FUN_0804eed0/FUN_0804efac/FUN_0804f004.
fields.name: golfer0_active

fields.description: Slot 0 golfer name packed as nine 6-bit chars at bits 3..56 (file bytes 1..8); baseline decodes to 'EMPTY'.
fields.evidence: FUN_08028448 packs 9 chars with 6 bits each from bit 3 (FUN_08028350 bit-writer, FUN_0804f24c char map); FUN_08028750 unpacks 6-bit values 1..26->A..Z, 0x1b..0x24->0..9; baseline bytes decode to EMPTY.
fields.name: golfer0_name_packed

fields.description: Slot 0 stored checksum word; custom XOR-shift-add algorithm (seed DAT_08028ee4), not a Schema v2 algorithm, so stored as a plain field.
fields.evidence: FUN_08028e2c computes over slot bytes [+1,+0x7f) and stores u16 at slot+0x80; FUN_08028eac verifies it; baseline slot0 holds 0xdc6d.
fields.name: golfer0_checksum
